Example Archiver for Confluence

Lifecycle management for Confluence content: statuses, owner notifications and automatic archiving, with dashboards so that you know what people and AI tools can safely trust. It is built for teams that keep thousands of pages.

  • Autonomous page statuses for every space
  • Automatic notifications to page owners
  • Archive or delete pages when they reach end of life
